0022600131.text: The Trail Blazers (2-0, second in the Northwest and fourth in the West) visit the Los Angeles Lakers (3-0, first in the Pacific and first in the West) for their third game of the 2026-27 season, with Portland on a two-game winning streak and 1-0 on the road. In the season series, no games have been played in 2026-27 so far, while Portland won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026. Shaedon Sharpe is out for Portland with a knee injury following surgery, and Branden Carlson (concussion) and Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness) are listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Los Angeles has Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Cameron Carr (oblique strain) out.
